title: Descriptive Text
summary: Descriptive text untuk TKA: fungsi sosial, struktur identification dan description, ciri kebahasaan, contoh teks beranotasi, dan strategi menjawab soal tentang tempat, benda, hewan, dan orang.

blocks.html:
Descriptive text menggambarkan sesuatu yang spesifik, misalnya satu tempat (Kawah Putih), satu benda (sasando), satu hewan (anoa), atau satu orang, sehingga pembaca dapat membayangkannya.

BagianIsi
Identificationmemperkenalkan apa yang digambarkan: nama, lokasi, kategori, mengapa terkenal
Descriptionrincian: bagian, ciri fisik, sifat, kebiasaan, fungsi, kegiatan di sana; biasanya satu aspek per paragraf

blocks.title: Ciri kebahasaan
blocks.html:
• Simple present tense: The lake is ..., It has ... (untuk tokoh atau benda yang sudah tidak ada, dipakai past tense).
  • Relational verbs: is, are, has, have, consists of, looks like.
  • Adjektiva dan frasa nomina: a bright turquoise lake, thick grey skin.
  • Kata keterangan tempat: in the north, next to, above, along.
  • Bahasa figuratif kadang dipakai: as white as snow, looks as if it is wearing armour.

blocks.question: Which sentence is most likely the identification part of a descriptive text?

options.A: Its walls are covered with old carvings.
options.B: Prambanan is a Hindu temple complex near Yogyakarta.
options.C: Visitors can climb the stairs to the top.
options.D: The main temple is about 47 metres high.

blocks.explanation: Kalimat B memperkenalkan nama, jenis, dan lokasi objek. Kalimat lain adalah rincian (description).

blocks.html:
The Anoa

[Identification] The anoa is a small wild buffalo that lives only on the island of Sulawesi and the nearby island of Buton. It is sometimes called a "dwarf buffalo" because it is much smaller than the water buffalo used by farmers.

[Description: appearance] An adult anoa stands about one metre tall at the shoulder and weighs around 150 to 300 kilograms. It has dark brown or black skin, with white markings on its legs and throat. Both males and females have short, straight horns that point backwards.

[Description: habitat and food] Anoas prefer to live in thick, undisturbed forests, usually close to water. They are shy animals and often hide during the day. They feed on grasses, ferns, fallen fruit, and young leaves.

[Description: status] Today the anoa is an endangered species. Its forest home is shrinking, and it is still hunted illegally for its meat. Several national parks in Sulawesi now protect the remaining populations.

blocks.title: Soal tekstual
blocks.question: Where does the anoa live?
steps: Paragraf 1: lives only on the island of Sulawesi and the nearby island of Buton.

blocks.title: Soal inferensial: makna kata
blocks.question: The word undisturbed in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ....
steps: Konteks: anoa pemalu dan bersembunyi, jadi menyukai hutan yang tidak diganggu manusia.
blocks.answer: not affected by people; quiet and natural

blocks.title: Soal evaluasi: detail pendukung
blocks.question: Which additional information would make paragraph 4 more informative?
steps: Informasi paling relevan: jumlah anoa yang tersisa atau nama taman nasional yang melindunginya.
Informasi tentang kerbau di sawah tidak relevan dengan paragraf ini.
blocks.answer: the estimated number of anoas left in the wild

blocks.question: According to the text, why is the anoa called a 'dwarf buffalo'?

options.B: It is much smaller than the water buffalo.

blocks.explanation: because it is much smaller than the water buffalo used by farmers.

lessons.title: Latihan interaktif: struktur dan ciri kebahasaan

blocks.title: Struktur dan ciri descriptive text
blocks.caption: Kelompokkan kalimat menurut bagian strukturnya, lalu coba set kedua untuk mengenali ciri kebahasaan descriptive text.

blocks.title: Strategi mengerjakan
blocks.html:
• Ide pokok tiap paragraf biasanya satu aspek (penampilan, habitat, fungsi). Pakai ini untuk soal main idea.
  • Soal The text mainly talks about ... dijawab dengan pilihan yang mencakup seluruh teks, tidak hanya satu paragraf.
  • Untuk soal fakta/opini, cari adjektiva penilaian (beautiful, warmest, best) dan frasa for me, I think.
  • Bandingkan informasi dengan cermat ketika soal meminta persamaan atau perbedaan dua objek.

blocks.title: Jebakan yang sering muncul
blocks.html:
• Memilih ide pokok yang terlalu sempit (hanya satu detail).
  • Mengira semua kalimat present tense pasti fakta.
  • Melewatkan kata pembatas seperti only, usually, most.
Setelah memahami materi dan contoh di atas, kerjakan kuis bab ini. Bacalah teksnya dengan teliti, jawab tanpa melihat pembahasan, lalu pelajari pembahasan setiap soal yang salah.
